name: Frederick
description: A sturdy, broad-shouldered man in his late thirties to mid-forties, photographed in a cinematic, photorealistic documentary style. Broad forehead with receding light-brown hair swept back, a full thick bushy mustache, calm blue-grey eyes, a steady confident expression, natural skin texture with weathered lines from outdoor exposure. Wears a heavy cream-and-tan fur anorak with a fur-lined hood pushed back, dark fur mittens, and thick sealskin boots, realistic fabric and fur texture.

name: Young Frederick
description: The SAME man as Frederick but in his mid-twenties, photographed in a cinematic, photorealistic documentary style — identical broad forehead and face shape, same light-brown hair (fuller, less receding), a neatly trimmed brown mustache. Youthful, slightly leaner face, earnest determined eyes, smooth natural skin texture. Wears a dark charcoal late-1800s wool physician's coat with a high collar over a waistcoat in the early scenes, or a plain brown wool expedition coat, realistic wool fabric texture.

name: Frederick Gaunt
description: The SAME man as Frederick after a fourteen-month Arctic ordeal — emaciated and skeletal, photographed in a cinematic, photorealistic documentary style. Same broad forehead and face structure but with deep sunken cheeks, hollow shadowed eyes, and a long ragged overgrown brown beard replacing the neat mustache. Frostbitten, weather-darkened skin with realistic texture and cracking. Wears a filthy tattered and frost-crusted fur anorak hanging loose on his thin frame, realistic worn and frayed fabric texture.

name: Robert
description: A tall, lean, imposing man in his late thirties to fifties, photographed in a cinematic, photorealistic documentary style. Very large distinctive reddish-brown walrus mustache dominating his face, receding auburn-red hair, piercing pale steel-blue eyes, a strong square jaw and stern determined expression, natural weathered skin texture. Wears a heavy grey-brown fur parka with a large fur hood ruff, fur mittens, and sealskin boots, realistic fur and fabric texture.

name: Young Robert
description: The SAME man as Robert but in his twenties, photographed in a cinematic, photorealistic documentary style — same strong square jaw and face shape, same auburn-red hair (fuller, less receding), a large reddish-brown mustache slightly smaller than in later years. Youthful confident face, natural smooth skin texture. Wears a dark navy-blue 1880s naval civil-engineer uniform jacket with brass buttons and a high collar, or a dark formal frock coat, realistic wool and brass texture.

name: Matthew
description: A strong, capable Black American man aged roughly twenty to early forties, photographed in a cinematic, photorealistic documentary style. Warm dark brown skin with natural realistic texture, close-cropped black hair, a neat black mustache and short beard, alert intelligent eyes, a calm resolute expression. Wears a dark brown fur anorak with a fur-lined hood, fur mittens, and sealskin boots, realistic fur and leather texture.

name: Young Matthew
description: The SAME person as Matthew but as a thirteen-year-old cabin boy, photographed in a cinematic, photorealistic documentary style — same warm dark brown skin and face shape, younger and rounder, short cropped black hair, no facial hair, bright curious eyes, natural smooth skin texture. Wears simple 1870s merchant-sailor clothes: a rough grey wool jacket, a dark knit cap, and worn trousers, realistic worn fabric texture.

name: Harry
description: A well-groomed wealthy American sportsman in his thirties, photographed in a cinematic, photorealistic documentary style. Clean-cut handsome face, neatly combed dark hair, a trim mustache, an easygoing refined expression, natural smooth well-kept skin texture. Wears an expensive fur-trimmed hunting parka in rich green-brown tones, tailored and clean compared to the weathered explorers, with leather gloves, realistic fine fabric and leather texture.

name: The Financier
description: A distinguished wealthy gentleman in his sixties, photographed in a cinematic, photorealistic documentary style. Silver-white hair and thick white side-whiskers (muttonchops), a broad clean-shaven chin, shrewd kindly eyes, natural aged skin texture with fine wrinkles. Wears a formal black 1890s frock coat with a waistcoat, a high white collar, and a dark cravat, realistic fine wool and cotton texture. Portly, dignified bearing.

name: The Blacksmith
description: A rugged working-class man in his forties, photographed in a cinematic, photorealistic documentary style. Broad muscular build, a thick unkempt dark-brown beard, weathered ruddy face with natural realistic skin texture, wary shifting eyes. Wears plain rough grey-brown wool work clothes, a leather apron, a flat cloth cap, and heavy boots, realistic worn fabric and leather texture.

name: The Older Hunter
description: An experienced older Inuit hunter, photographed in a cinematic, photorealistic documentary style. Weathered broad face with high cheekbones, warm brown skin with natural realistic texture, dark eyes with squint lines, black hair under his hood. Wears traditional thick caribou-skin fur clothing: a fur anorak with a rounded hood, fur trousers, and sealskin boots, all in warm brown and cream tones, realistic fur texture. Calm, capable expression.

name: The Younger Hunter
description: A younger Inuit hunter in his twenties, photographed in a cinematic, photorealistic documentary style. Smooth broad face with high cheekbones, warm brown skin with natural realistic texture, dark eyes, black hair under his hood. Wears traditional caribou-skin fur clothing similar to The Older Hunter — a fur anorak with a rounded hood, fur trousers, sealskin boots — but in slightly darker grey-brown tones to tell them apart, realistic fur texture. Alert, energetic expression.
